text:
TREATMENT OF NEOPLASMS OF THE SALIVARY GLAND
- Benign and malignant lesions: surgical excision
- Malignant lesions: radiotherapy and chemotherapy in addition to excision
- Secondary bacterial infections: treat with antibiotics e.g. ciprofloxacin 500
mg orally every 12 hours for 5-7 days
- Adjust doses as appropriate for children
